map.端面模数 mt、齿数 z、螺旋角 β（β=0 即直齿）：分度圆 d = mt×z: Transverse module mt, tooth count z, helix angle β (β=0 means spur gear): pitch circle d = mt×z; addendum circle da = mt×(z+2), dedendum circle df = mt×(z−2.5), base circle db = d×cos20° (standard pressure angle 20°); transverse pitch pt = π×mt; normal module mn = mt×cosβ; axial pitch px = π×mt/tanβ (none for spur gears). Hob/shaping spindle speed n = 1000×Vc ÷ (π×d) (rpm), feed rate Vf = n×f (mm/min). Validation: transverse module must be a positive number, tooth count at least 4, helix angle 0–45°, cutting speed and feed > 0, otherwise each field is flagged. Criterion: warn when hobbing n>500 rpm or shaping n>800 rpm; recommended Vc is also shown from the material table.
